title: Yotta Website Platform
description: Filter by Namespace (platform, aiops, observability, user1, user2...) and Service (container). Overview -> pods -> CPU -> memory -> network -> website traffic -> HTTP errors per service -> Kafka and website events -> platform database -> logs.

panels.title: Running containers
panels.description: Containers of the selected services that exist right now (one per pod for these services).

panels.title: Not ready
panels.description: Containers failing their readiness probe. Should be 0.

panels.title: Waiting (CrashLoop, ImagePull…)
panels.description: Containers stuck in a waiting state; see 'Why containers are not running' below.

panels.title: CPU used / requested
panels.description: Above 100% the pods use more than they reserve.

panels.title: Memory used / limit
panels.description: Near 100% a container is about to be OOM-killed.

panels.title: Ready pods per service
panels.description: Pod count over time; drops show restarts or failed rollouts.

panels.title: Container restarts (15m)
panels.description: Only pods that restarted are shown.

panels.title: Why containers are not running (waiting / last termination)
panels.description: CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, OOMKilled, Error... Empty = healthy.

targets.expr: (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service"} == 1) and on (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service"}[1h]) > 0)

panels.title: CPU usage % of limit
panels.description: Close to 100% the container is throttled.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service", container!=""}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service", resource="cpu"})

panels.title: CPU throttling (% of periods)
panels.description: High throttling = CPU limit too low: slow responses, failing probes.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service", container!=""}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service", container!=""}[5m]))

panels.title: Memory working set by pod
panels.description: What the OOM killer compares against the limit.

panels.title: Memory % of limit
panels.description: At 100% the container is OOM-killed.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service", container!=""}) / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service", resource="memory"})

sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service"})

sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"$service"})

panels.title: HTTP request rate by status code
HTTP errors per service (4XX / 5XX, at the ingress)
4XX responses in time range
panels.description: Client errors: 400 bad request, 404 not found, 409 conflict, 422 invalid input...

panels.title: 5XX responses in time range
panels.description: Server errors: 500, 502 bad gateway (pod down), 503 unavailable, 504 timeout.

panels.title: 4XX rate (% of requests)
panels.description: From ingress-nginx: every request that comes in through the Ingress (tenant websites, the hosting-platform API, Grafana/Prometheus). Lines are namespace/service. Filtered by Namespace only.

panels.title: 5XX rate (% of requests)
panels.description: From ingress-nginx: every request that comes in through the Ingress (tenant websites, the hosting-platform API, Grafana/Prometheus). Lines are namespace/service. Filtered by Namespace only.

panels.title: 4XX responses per minute by service
panels.description: From ingress-nginx: every request that comes in through the Ingress (tenant websites, the hosting-platform API, Grafana/Prometheus). Lines are namespace/service. Filtered by Namespace only.

panels.title: 5XX responses per minute by service
panels.description: From ingress-nginx: every request that comes in through the Ingress (tenant websites, the hosting-platform API, Grafana/Prometheus). Lines are namespace/service. Filtered by Namespace only.

panels.title: 4XX and 5XX by service and status code
panels.description: Per minute. From ingress-nginx: every request that comes in through the Ingress (tenant websites, the hosting-platform API, Grafana/Prometheus). Lines are namespace/service. Filtered by Namespace only.

panels.title: Error rate by service (%)
panels.description: Share of each service's requests that failed. From ingress-nginx: every request that comes in through the Ingress (tenant websites, the hosting-platform API, Grafana/Prometheus). Lines are namespace/service. Filtered by Namespace only.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, service) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", status=~"4.."}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, service) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))

100 * sum by (namespace, service) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (namespace, service) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m]))

panels.title: Kafka brokers up
panels.description: From kafka-exporter. 0 = Kafka down or exporter cannot reach it.

panels.title: Messages in website-events
panels.description: All website events ever written to the topic.

panels.title: Unprocessed events (orchestrator lag)
panels.description: Events in the queue the orchestrator has not handled yet. Should return to 0.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="platform", container="website-orchestrator"} |= "WEBSITE_EVENT" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | regexp `event_type=(?P<event_type>\S+) tenant=(?P<tenant>\S+) domain=(?P<domain>\S+)` | event_type="WebsiteProvisioningRequested" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({namespace="platform", container="website-orchestrator"} |= "WEBSITE_EVENT" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | regexp `event_type=(?P<event_type>\S+) tenant=(?P<tenant>\S+) domain=(?P<domain>\S+)` | event_type="WebsiteCreated" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({namespace="platform", container="website-orchestrator"} |= "WEBSITE_EVENT" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | regexp `event_type=(?P<event_type>\S+) tenant=(?P<tenant>\S+) domain=(?P<domain>\S+)` | event_type="WebsiteDeploymentFailed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Kafka messages per minute by topic
Consumer lag (queue backlog)
panels.description: Rising lag = the orchestrator is down or failing on a message (see its logs).

targets.expr: sum by (event_type) (count_over_time({namespace="platform", container="website-orchestrator"} |= "WEBSITE_EVENT" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | regexp `event_type=(?P<event_type>\S+) tenant=(?P<tenant>\S+) domain=(?P<domain>\S+)` [$__interval]))

sum by (tenant, event_type) (count_over_time({namespace="platform", container="website-orchestrator"} |= "WEBSITE_EVENT" | json | line_format "{{.log}}" | regexp `event_type=(?P<event_type>\S+) tenant=(?P<tenant>\S+) domain=(?P<domain>\S+)` | tenant=~"$namespace" [$__interval]))

panels.title: PostgreSQL volume usage
panels.description: Empty if the storage driver does not report volume stats (Kind local-path).
